lead: A capability is invisible through the request overlay, so narrowing one via `Core\Config::set` pins nothing.
body: `capability::refusal` reads `config.snapshot().config.capabilities`, never the `Request` overlay, and `Request::set` refuses the block anyway: a grant is a list, with no quantity to compare. Narrow a capability in the snapshot, as `a_child_cannot_widen_a_capability_its_parent_narrowed` does.
